PF1DC.Abilities.spell_resistance_19.Name: Spell Resistance 19

PF1DC.Abilities.reflecting.Desc: Once per day, the armor can reflect a spell back at its caster as if using spell turning...
PF1DC.Abilities.delving.Name: Delving
PF1DC.Abilities.delving.Desc: The wearer gains a burrow speed of 10 feet...
PF1DC.Abilities.poison_resistant.Name: Poison-Resistant

PF1DC.Abilities.glamered_armor.Name: Glamered

PF1DC.Abilities.harmonizing.Desc: The wearer gains a +5 bonus on Perform checks but a -5 penalty on Stealth checks, and takes 50% more sonic damage...
PF1DC.Abilities.jousting.Name: Jousting
PF1DC.Abilities.jousting.Desc: The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Ride checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.shadow.Name: Shadow
PF1DC.Abilities.shadow.Desc: The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.shadow_improved.Name: Shadow, Improved
PF1DC.Abilities.shadow_improved.Desc: The wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Stealth checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.shadow_greater.Name: Shadow, Greater
PF1DC.Abilities.shadow_greater.Desc: The wearer gains a +15 competence bonus on Stealth checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.slick.Name: Slick
PF1DC.Abilities.slick.Desc: The wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.slick_improved.Name: Slick, Improved
PF1DC.Abilities.slick_improved.Desc: The wearer gains a +10 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.slick_greater.Name: Slick, Greater
PF1DC.Abilities.slick_greater.Desc: The wearer gains a +15 competence bonus on Escape Artist checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.energy_resistance.Name: Energy Resistance
PF1DC.Abilities.energy_resistance.Desc: The armor absorbs the first 10 points of a specific energy type...

PF1DC.Abilities.energy_resistance_greate: The armor absorbs the first 30 points of a specific energy type...

PF1DC.Abilities.expeditious.Desc: Three times per day as a swift action, the wearer gains a +10-foot enhancement bonus to movement speed for 1 round...
PF1DC.Abilities.martyrring.Name: Martyrring
PF1DC.Abilities.martyrring.Desc: Once per day as an immediate action when critically hit, the wearer can heal up to 9 allies within 30 feet...
PF1DC.Abilities.burdenless.Name: Burdenless
PF1DC.Abilities.burdenless.Desc: The wearer's carrying capacity increases by 50%...
PF1DC.Abilities.righteous.Name: Righteous
PF1DC.Abilities.righteous.Desc: Once per day on command, the wearer can use righteous might...
PF1DC.Abilities.amorphous.Name: Amorphous
PF1DC.Abilities.amorphous.Desc: Once per day on command, the wearer can assume a liquid form...
PF1DC.Abilities.unbound.Name: Unbound
PF1DC.Abilities.unbound.Desc: Once per day on command, the wearer can use righteous might, but gains DR 5/lawful instead...
PF1DC.Abilities.restful.Name: Restful
PF1DC.Abilities.restful.Desc: The wearer only needs 2 hours of sleep to gain the benefits of a full night's rest...
PF1DC.Abilities.unrighteous.Name: Unrighteous
PF1DC.Abilities.unrighteous.Desc: Once per day on command, the wearer can use righteous might, but the effect is evil-aligned...
PF1DC.Abilities.vigilant.Name: Vigilant
PF1DC.Abilities.vigilant.Desc: Once per day on command, the wearer can use righteous might, but gains DR 5/chaotic instead...
PF1DC.Abilities.cloudburst.Name: Cloudburst
PF1DC.Abilities.cloudburst.Desc: If the wearer takes at least 10 points of electricity damage, the armor can channel it into a shocking grasp effect...
PF1DC.Abilities.creeping.Name: Creeping
PF1DC.Abilities.creeping.Desc: Once per day on command, the wearer can add the armor's enhancement bonus to Stealth checks for 1 minute...
PF1DC.Abilities.determination.Name: Determination
PF1DC.Abilities.determination.Desc: Once per day, when the wearer's HP drops to 0 or below, the armor automatically activates breath of life...
PF1DC.Abilities.rallying.Name: Rallying
PF1DC.Abilities.rallying.Desc: Allies within 30 feet gain a +4 morale bonus on saves against fear...
PF1DC.Abilities.adhesive.Name: Adhesive
PF1DC.Abilities.adhesive.Desc: On command, the wearer's hands and feet become incredibly sticky, granting a climb speed and bonuses on combat maneuvers...
PF1DC.Abilities.spiteful.Name: Spiteful
PF1DC.Abilities.spiteful.Desc: If an enemy's melee attack would drop the wearer to 0 HP or below, the wearer can spend 1 panache point to make a single melee attack against that enemy...
PF1DC.Abilities.trackless.Name: Trackless
PF1DC.Abilities.trackless.Desc: Tracking the wearer has a -5 penalty, and the wearer gains a +5 competence bonus on Stealth checks...
PF1DC.Abilities.etherealness.Name: Etherealness
PF1DC.Abilities.etherealness.Desc: Once per day on command, the wearer can become ethereal...
PF1DC.Abilities.hosteling.Name: Hosteling
PF1DC.Abilities.hosteling.Desc: The armor can store an animal companion, familiar, or mount...
PF1DC.Abilities.undead_controlling.Name: Undead Controlling
PF1DC.Abilities.undead_controlling.Desc: The wearer can control up to 26 HD of undead per day...
PF1DC.Abilities.radiant.Name: Radiant
PF1DC.Abilities.radiant.Desc: The armor glows like a torch and once per day can emit daylight...
PF1DC.Abilities.wyrmbreath.Name: Wyrmbreath

PF1DC.Traits.Perk.lightweight.Name: Lightweight
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.lightweight.Desc: The item weighs half as much as normal.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.durable.Name: Durable
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.durable.Desc: The item has twice the normal hit points.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.sturdy.Name: Sturdy

PF1DC.Traits.Perk.energy_affinity.Desc: The item is immune to one random energy type, but does not grant this immunity to the wielder.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.holy.Name: Holy
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.holy.Desc: The item bears a glowing holy or unholy symbol...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.devout.Name: Devout
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.devout.Desc: When beneficial to the creator's deity's followers, the caster level is treated as 1 higher...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.shielded.Name: Shielded
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.shielded.Desc: The item negates the first magic missile directed at it or its wielder each day...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.tentacle.Name: Tentacle
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.tentacle.Desc: Like a quirk, but the tentacle can stretch, allowing delivery of touch spells with an extra 5 feet of reach.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.secret_mark.Name: Secret Mark
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.secret_mark.Desc: The wielder can spend a full-round action to carve up to 25 words of hidden information...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.eager.Name: Eager
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.eager.Desc: The wielder can draw the eager weapon or held item as a swift action...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.enemy_detection.Name: Enemy Detection
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.enemy_detection.Desc: The item glows when a specific type of enemy approaches.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.hatred.Name: Hatred
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.hatred.Desc: This weapon deals 1 point of extra damage against a specific creature type.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.proficient.Name: Proficient
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.proficient.Desc: The item grants a +1 competence bonus on a random skill.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.paragon.Name: Paragon
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.paragon.Desc: The item is a perfect example of its kind, granting a +1 AC bonus against similar weapons...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.humble.Name: Humble
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.humble.Desc: The item appears nonmagical, as if affected by magic aura.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.lucky.Name: Lucky
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.lucky.Desc: Each day, the item has a 50% chance to grant the wielder a +1 luck bonus on a random type of save.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.dragon_blood.Name: Dragon Blood
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.dragon_blood.Desc: Randomly determine a type of chromatic or metallic dragon, granting the wielder 3 points of energy resistance...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.linked.Name: Linked
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.linked.Desc: The item is linked to its wielder, who can command it mentally...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.messenger.Name: Messenger
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.messenger.Desc: Once per week, the item can become an animal and deliver a message...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.healthy.Name: Healthy
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.healthy.Desc: When healed by any magic effect, the wielder recovers an extra 1 hit point.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.charged.Name: Charged
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.charged.Desc: The item deals 1 point of extra energy damage...
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.moonlight.Name: Moonlight
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.moonlight.Desc: When exposed to moonlight, adjacent enemies take a -1 penalty on saves against sleep effects.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.sunlight.Name: Sunlight
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.sunlight.Desc: When exposed to sunlight, adjacent enemies are blinded.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.potential.Name: Potential
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.potential.Desc: The item's caster level is 1 higher than normal.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.spy.Name: Spy

PF1DC.Traits.Perk.scaling.Name: Scaling
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.scaling.Desc: The item automatically changes size to fit its wielder.
PF1DC.Traits.Perk.selfish.Name: Selfish

PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.flaw.Name: Flaw

PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.arrogant.Desc: The item only activates if asked with 'please', otherwise it refuses to work for 1 hour.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.dirty.Name: Dirty
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.dirty.Desc: The item is constantly covered in sludge.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.junk.Name: Junk
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.junk.Desc: The item looks old and rusted, hiding its true power.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.powerful.Name: Powerful

PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.verdant.Name: Verdant
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.verdant.Desc: Leaves and moss cover the item.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.noisy.Name: Noisy
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.noisy.Desc: The item makes a loud noise when used.

PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.molt.Name: Molt
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.molt.Desc: The item is covered in scaly skin and occasionally molts.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.high_pitch.Name: High Pitch
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.high_pitch.Desc: The wielder's voice rises by an octave.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.low_pitch.Name: Low Pitch
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.low_pitch.Desc: The wielder's voice drops by an octave.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.big_ears.Name: Big Ears
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.big_ears.Desc: The wielder's ears grow 5 times larger.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.big_nose.Name: Big Nose
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.big_nose.Desc: The wielder's nose grows 5 times larger.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.soul_bound.Name: Soul Bound
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.soul_bound.Desc: The item is closely tied to its designated owner and cannot be stolen or transferred.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.shared_race.Name: Shared Race
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.shared_race.Desc: The wielder is treated as an additional race matching one of its creators.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.loyal.Name: Loyal
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.loyal.Desc: Grants a perk when used by the creator, but a flaw when used by others.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.wet.Name: Wet
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.wet.Desc: The item is constantly soaked. -1 against cold/electricity, +1 against fire.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.slimy.Name: Slimy
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.slimy.Desc: The item is covered in slime. +5 Escape Artist, but -2 Acrobatics/Disable Device/Disguise.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.unstable.Name: Unstable
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.unstable.Desc: When activated, roll d6; on a 5 or 6, the DC and caster level increase by 1 for this activation.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.focus.Name: Focus
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.focus.Desc: Connects to another plane, granting telepathy with extraplanar beings.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.sparkly.Name: Sparkly
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.sparkly.Desc: The item leaves a trail of glowing magical particles when moved.
PF1DC.Traits.Quirk.perk.Name: Perk
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.heavy.Name: Heavy
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.heavy.Desc: The item weighs twice as much as normal.

PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.fragile.Desc: The item has half the normal hit points.

PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.faerie_fire.Name: Faerie Fire
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.faerie_fire.Desc: The wielder is surrounded by a colored light, as the faerie fire spell.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.high_pitch_sing.Name: High Pitch Singing
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.high_pitch_sing.Desc: The item constantly sings in a loud, high pitch.

PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.gluttony.Name: Addicted (Gluttony)
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.gluttony.Desc: Must consume 10 times the normal amount of food.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.lazy.Name: Lazy
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.lazy.Desc: Must rest for 12 hours per day to prepare spells.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.hallucination.Name: Hallucination

PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.submissive.Name: Submissive
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.submissive.Desc: -2 on Will saves against mind control.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.wild_terrain.Name: Wild Terrain
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.wild_terrain.Desc: The item fails in urban terrain.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.allergy.Name: Allergy
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.allergy.Desc: Magic effects end when specific creatures are within 30 feet.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.fanatic.Name: Fanatic

PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.powerless.Name: Powerless
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.powerless.Desc: The item's caster level is 1 lower than normal.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.peaceful.Name: Peaceful
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.peaceful.Desc: This weapon can only deal nonlethal damage.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.backlash.Name: Backlash
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.backlash.Desc: When attacking or activating, the user takes 1d6 magical damage.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.rage.Name: Rage
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.rage.Desc: In combat, must pass a DC 20 Will save or be unable to use it (like rage).
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.arrogance.Name: Arrogance
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.arrogance.Desc: The wielder cannot gain or grant benefits from aid another actions.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.slippery.Name: Slippery
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.slippery.Desc: Must pass a DC 15 Reflex save each round or drop the item.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.tempting.Name: Tempting
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.tempting.Desc: Others must pass a DC 20 Will save or try to take it.
PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.paranoid.Name: Paranoid

PF1DC.Traits.Flaw.cursed.Name: Cursed
